attempts.raw: {"risk": 2, "reason": "Refactors query-string building into a shared MediaCommands type and reorders format-before-quality logic across multiple call sites (filters, shortcodes, formatter, profile service), which is well-covered by new tests but touches widely-used image URL generation so any subtle behavior change (e.g., in ordering or null-handling) could affect rendered image URLs across many themes/modules."}

reason: Refactors query-string building into a shared MediaCommands type and reorders format-before-quality logic across multiple call sites (filters, shortcodes, formatter, profile service), which is well-covered by new tests but touches widely-used image URL generation so any subtle behavior change (e.g., in ordering or null-handling) could affect rendered image URLs across many themes/modules.
